_comment: REAL misattributions — the checker is RIGHT about every entry here. This is NOT the allowlist: nothing in this file is a false positive. It exists only so a known backlog does not block unrelated work while it burns down, and it is what makes --gate-absent a ratchet: a citation added tomorrow with the same defect fails immediately, because it is not in here. Keys are '<identifier>|<canonical name>' in `entries`; load_backlog in pipeline/audit/citation_topicality.py rejects any other shape.
_rule: DO NOT ADD TO THIS FILE. Fix the row instead — re-source it, or drop the number. Delete the entry when you do: --gate-absent fails on an entry that is no longer flagged.
